question:
What is the mode of the data given below? [Give your answer correct to 2 decimal places.]

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the **modal class** with the highest frequency: 35−45 (frequency = 39).

Calculate differences: d₁ = 39 − 32 = 7 and d₂ = 39 − 38 = 1.

Apply shortcut: **Mode** = Lower limit + [d₁ ÷ (d₁ + d₂)] × Class width.

Mode = 35 + [7 ÷ (7 + 1)] × 10 = 35 + 8.75 = 43.75.

**∴ The correct answer is 43.75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Modal class = 35−45, Lower limit (l) = 35, Frequency (f₁) = 39, Preceding frequency (f₀) = 32, Succeeding frequency (f₂) = 38, Class size (h) = 10.

**Formula:** Mode = l + [(f₁ − f₀) ÷ (2f₁ − f₀ − f₂)] × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/beaf5f75e110e2ecf7c9110e88f5a6be93bc44351c4717f618820afb69fdc19b.png] 

⇒ Mode = 35 + [(39 − 32) ÷ (2 × 39 − 32 − 38)] × 10

⇒ Mode = 35 + [7 ÷ (78 − 70)] × 10

⇒ Mode = 35 + [7 ÷ 8] × 10

⇒ Mode = 35 + 0.875 × 10

⇒ Mode = 35 + 8.75 = 43.75
